requirements_to_testpoints.requirement_text: 使用 按钮（D2）+ TM1637 + LED（D13）：计数并根据奇偶切换 LED
requirements_to_testpoints.stimulus: Perform two rising press edges on input io_0 (press from false->true twice), with at least one control step between edges.
requirements_to_testpoints.oracle: After first press, io_2 increments to 1 and io_1 is true (odd). After second press, io_2 increments to 2 and io_1 is false (even).

requirements_to_testpoints.requirement_text: 使用 按钮（D2）+ TM1637 + LED（D13）：计数并根据奇偶切换 LED
requirements_to_testpoints.stimulus: Hold io_0 continuously true for multiple control steps, then release to false and press again for one control step.
requirements_to_testpoints.oracle: count (io_2) increments only once on the initial rising edge of the hold, does not increment while io_0 remains true, increments once again on the next rising edge after release, and io_1 always reflects the parity of the updated io_2.
